title: Head Tail
statement: Implement `solve(items)`. `items` is a non-empty list. Return `[head, tail]` where `head` is the first element and `tail` is the list of the rest. The rest may be empty. Do not mutate the input.
constraints: tail is a list, not a leftover scalar
hints: A one-element list has an empty tail.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Starred unpacking splits a sequence into the first element and a new list of the remainder.

editorial: Starred unpacking splits a sequence into the first element and a new list of the remainder. That is the head/tail recursion pattern without a slice you might forget is a copy. The tail is always a list so the caller can unpack again.
